title: CacheLink: Functional KV Transport for Zero-Prefill Cross-Model Context Handoff
abstract: arXiv:2610.15509v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: KV caches make long-context serving efficient by reusing past computation, but model switching breaks this reuse and forces the receiver to prefill the context again. We study \emph{zero-prefill cross-model context handoff}: translating a sender cache into a receiver-compatible state so that the receiver can continue directly without prefilling same context. Existing affine transport methods show that receiver KV states can be substantially reconstructed from sender caches. However, through extensive analyses, we find that reconstruction fidelity is a poor proxy for receiver utility. Similar K/V reconstruction errors can lead to substantially different attention patterns, predictive distributions, and downstream accuracy, because conventional reconstruction objectives overlook the query-dependent functional importance of K and V in receiver attention. translated_title: CacheLink：面向零预填充跨模型上下文交接的功能性KV传输
translated_abstract: KV缓存通过复用先前的计算使长上下文服务变得高效，但模型切换会破坏这种复用，迫使接收方对相同上下文重新进行预填充。我们研究“零预填充跨模型上下文交接”问题：将发送方的缓存转换为接收方可兼容的状态，使接收方无需重新预填充相同上下文即可直接继续推理。现有的仿射传输方法表明，接收方的KV状态可以从发送方缓存中被大幅重建。然而，通过大量分析，我们发现重建保真度并不是衡量接收方效用的良好指标：相似的K/V重建误差可能导致截然不同的注意力模式、预测分布和下游准确率，因为传统的重建目标忽略了K和V在接收方注意力中依赖于查询的功能重要性。因此，我们提出了CACHELINK，它通过接收……学习一种耦合的K/V修正（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文发现KV缓存的重建保真度并不能反映接收模型的实际效用，并提出CacheLink，通过学习与查询相关的耦合K/V修正，将发送方模型的KV缓存转换为接收方模型可直接使用的状态，从而实现无需重新预填充的零预填充跨模型上下文交接。
en_tdlr: CacheLink observes that KV reconstruction fidelity is a poor proxy for receiver utility and learns a query-aware coupled K/V correction to translate a sender's cache into a receiver-compatible state, enabling zero-prefill cross-model context handoff.
